source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: لما كنا صغار، أنا وصاحبي سامي كنا ما ننفصل.
sentences.en: When we were young, my friend Sami and I were inseparable.

sentences.ar: كل يوم كنا نلعب سوا ونحلم سوا.
sentences.en: Every day we would play together and dream together.

sentences.ar: مرة، وقفنا عالتلة اللي فوق الضيعة.
sentences.en: Once, we stood on the hill above the village.

sentences.ar: سامي قال: خلينا نوعد بعض نضل أصحاب للأبد.
sentences.en: Sami said: let's promise each other to stay friends forever.
I extended my hand and told him: promise.

sentences.ar: بس الحياة فرقتنا، هو سافر وأنا ضليت.
sentences.en: But life separated us; he traveled and I stayed.

sentences.ar: مرت سنين طويلة وما سمعت عنه خبر.
sentences.en: Long years passed and I heard no news of him.

sentences.ar: كنت أفكر فيه كل ما أطلع عالتلة.
sentences.en: I would think of him every time I climbed the hill.

sentences.ar: يوم، وأنا قاعد بالبيت، دق التلفون.
sentences.en: One day, while I was sitting at home, the phone rang.

sentences.ar: صوت قال: بتذكر الوعد اللي وعدناه؟
sentences.en: A voice said: do you remember the promise we made?

sentences.ar: عرفت الصوت على طول، كان سامي.
sentences.en: I recognized the voice right away, it was Sami.

sentences.ar: قال إنه راجع عالضيعة بعد كل هالسنين.
sentences.en: He said he was returning to the village after all these years.
We agreed to meet on the hill, the same spot.

sentences.ar: لما شفته، عرفته رغم إنه كبر.
sentences.en: When I saw him, I recognized him even though he had aged.

sentences.ar: عانقنا بعض وضحكنا وبكينا بنفس الوقت.
sentences.en: We hugged and laughed and cried at the same time.

sentences.ar: قال: قلتلك رح نضل أصحاب للأبد.
sentences.en: He said: I told you we'd stay friends forever.
